title: Soren will not look at you
_note: Locked dialogue from docs/VERTICAL_SLICE_SCRIPT.md. Arabic lives here, never in C++ source. Stops at the choice. The chooser UI does not exist yet - see docs/NARRATIVE_RUNTIME.md. Until it does, play VS07a or VS07b directly; both end on the same Malik line.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.en: They said he asked for a boat. Raynor does not ask for boats.
lines.ar: قالوا إنه طلب قاربًا. رينور لا يطلب قوارب.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.en: He takes the path along the wall.
lines.ar: هو يمشي على الدرب بمحاذاة السور.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: You heard father say my name.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.en: I hear a lot of things I am not invited to keep.
lines.ar: أسمع أشياء كثيرة لم يدعُني أحد لأحتفظ بها.
